organizationName: Yonas Chercher Prime Beef (ዮናስ ጨርጨር የሥጋ ቤት)

menuItems.name: ልዩ ሸክላ ጥብስ (Shekla Tibs)
menuItems.description: Sizzling hot claypot tender ox beef cubes seared with fresh rosemary, garlic, sliced onions, and green chilies.
menuItems.pairingNote: Best paired with ice-cold Ambo Mineral Water & fresh Dabo

menuItems.name: ጥሬ ሥጋ / ቁርት (Prime Kurt)
menuItems.description: 100% Fresh morning slaughter prime Harar/Chercher ox beef sliced to order, served with house Awaze & Senafich.
menuItems.pairingNote: Served with spicy house Awaze, Senafich & Mitmita

menuItems.name: ልዩ ክትፎ (Special Kitfo)
menuItems.description: Finely minced lean beef infused with aromatic spiced Niter Kibbeh & Mitmita, served with Ayib, Gomen & Kocho.
menuItems.pairingNote: Garnished with fresh Ayib (cottage cheese), Gomen & Kocho

menuItems.name: ቀዝቃዛ አምቦ ውሀ (Ambo Water)
menuItems.description: Naturally sparkling Ethiopian mineral water — essential digestion companion for beef dishes.
menuItems.pairingNote: Essential digestive companion for meat dishes
